question: The mass of an atom is nearly concentrated in its nucleus. Justify this statement using the composition of an atom.

options.A: Atomic mass is mainly concentrated in electrons because electrons are more massive than nucleons.
options.B: Atomic mass is spread uniformly throughout the electron cloud because protons and neutrons are massless.
options.C: The nucleus contains protons and neutrons, each much more massive than an electron. Since electrons contribute very little mass, nearly all atomic mass is concentrated in the nucleus.
options.D: The atom's mass is mainly concentrated in empty space between the nucleus and electrons.
